commit: refactor(core): run the print pre-check for every printer in the core print loop

truth.description: mainPrintInternal now runs ensurePrintingNode before its empty-value return, but printFunctionType in type-annotation.js still calls print("predicate") and print("typeAnnotation") on every TSFunctionType and FunctionTypeAnnotation it holds, keys neither node type lists in its visitor keys, so outside a production build formatting any TypeScript or Flow function type such as type F = () => void throws the non-node error.

distractions.why: path.getParentNode() skips over a missing value, so for print() on an absent property it would return the wrong ancestor, while path.stack[path.stack.length - 3] is always the node that holds the printed property.
